research_status: exploratory; extends code/designs/border_discontinuity/statewide_design.json (border_statewide_aewr_v1) from 22 within-region border pairs to every county in a multi-state former AEWR region; that registry and its outputs are unchanged

policy_event.rule: 2025-10-02 interim final rule: statewide OEWS-based field-and-livestock AEWRs by skill level
policy_event.legal_status: unverified: litigation, stays or injunctions after 2025-10-02 cannot be checked without a network call; user must confirm that the statewide rates applied throughout FY2026 Q1-Q3 before estimation

period.preperiod_rate: nonrange_reference / fls_common_soc_reference regional AEWR from aewr_rate_schedule (covered_workers)

seasonal_window.primary: case decisions dated 1 October through 30 June of each FY (Q1-Q3), every FY
seasonal_window.reason: FY2026 disclosures end at Q3; pre and post outcomes must cover the same seasonal window
seasonal_window.check: full-FY pre-period outcome (all decisions) reported alongside to show how much Q4 matters

period.transition_note: job orders submitted before 2025-10-02 carry the prior regional rate; the primary estimate is intent-to-treat on the statutory rate and is attenuated by these cases

treatment.units_note: PPI for FY2026 is unavailable; former-region x FY FE absorb each year's level, so real units are a year-specific rescaling of within-region gaps
treatment.dose: FY2026 statewide rate minus the FY2025 regional rate (April 1, 2025); within former region this equals the FY2026 statewide rate up to a region constant
treatment.skill_level_note: skill level is an employer choice; the statutory skill-I rate is the intent-to-treat treatment
treatment.cohort_aligned_sensitivity: FY2026 cases whose case_received_date precedes 2025-10-02 are assigned the prior regional rate; county treatment is the certified-position-weighted mean of assigned rates; labeled sensitivity, not primary

outcomes.numerator: certified positions (adjusted_nbr_workers_certified) in h2a_allocated_worksites rows whose case decision_date falls in Q1-Q3 of the FY
outcomes.construction: b01 fiscal-year logic (code/b01_derived/01_h2a_aggregation_nodupes.R, h2a_fiscal_year_df): rows with a period begin date; each row split equally across county_fips_list; withdrawn/denied rows already zeroed by b01; decision_date is the first nonempty disclosure decision_date by case_number and fiscal_year
outcomes.missing_numerator: zero for counties with positive fixed denominator
outcomes.units: certified positions per fixed 2011 farm worker

outcomes.numerator: certified contract hours = (period_end - period_begin)/7 x number_of_hours x certified positions, b01 rule; missing number_of_hours replaced by the pooled mean as in b01
outcomes.units: certified hours per fixed 2011 farm worker

outcomes.construction: PPML of certified positions and of certified hours (counts) on the treatment with county and former-region x FY FE; semi-elasticity; size-weighted estimand
hours-weighted hourly offered wage (wage_unit hourly, 0 < wage <= 100, b01 HOURLY_WAGE_MAX) over certified hours of Q1-Q3 decisions
outcomes.sample: counties with hourly-offer certified hours in every calibration year; post estimation also requires FY2026 offers

geography.single_state_former_regions: dropped: they contribute no within-region contrast (support script reports which)
geography.sample: all counties with positive emp_farm_2011 in multi-state former AEWR regions; balanced county x FY panel

fixed_effects_note: the national level change of the rule is absorbed and not identified; only post-2025 within-former-region dispersion identifies the slope

inference.wild_bootstrap: restricted Webb wild cluster bootstrap over states, 9999 draws, seed 20261102, full FE/nuisance projection (explorations/bite/cross_design_helpers.R bite_wild)
inference.randomization_inference: permute FY2026 state doses across states within former region (exact enumeration where feasible, otherwise 9999 draws, seed 20261102); reported as a design-based reference under within-region exchangeability of doses

event_study.specification: dose x FY indicators, reference FY2025, county + former-region x FY FE, state CRV1
event_study.pre_trend_test: joint Wald on FY2012-FY2024 dose x FY coefficients; plus a linear dose x FY trend

sensitivities: applicable state agricultural minimum wage (nominal, April 1 of FY) as a control
warning_checks: dose vs FY2024-to-FY2025 county outcome growth within former region (state CRV1): a nonzero slope warns of differential pre-policy momentum (e.g. enforcement-driven demand)

calibration.primary_reason: FY2020 onward allocates certifications with Addendum B worksite records, the measurement regime of the post period
calibration.projection: county and former-region x FY FE only; no treatment regressor

power.settings_source: code/designs/border_discontinuity/design.json redesign.power and redesign.precision_assumptions (seed 201103, 999 repetitions, 999 calibration repetitions, AR(1) 0.5, spatial graph coefficient 0.4, size gate upper-Wilson 95% null rejection <= 0.075, alpha 0.05, target power 0.80)

dgp_mapping.shared_region_and_pair_serial: 0.25 state + 0.25 former-region (absorbed by FE; calibration rescales) + 0.5 county
dgp_mapping.spatial_region_serial: 0.5 state AR(1) loaded on the state contiguity graph + 0.25 former-region + 0.25 county

power.node_interpretation: border machinery's region shocks are state shocks; its pair shocks become former-region shocks

cert_positions_q1q3.note: border_statewide_aewr_v1 threshold: 10 positions per 1,000 2011 farm workers per nominal dollar

all_outcomes.note: plan gate: elasticity MDE = 2.8 x SE x mean price / mean outcome <= 1.0, using pre-period calibration means

power.decision: a threshold passes when every shared-dependence DGP passes the size gate for the inference method, power at both signs of the threshold is >= 0.80, and the largest size-valid MDE is <= the threshold
not_simulated: wild bootstrap and randomization inference (observed-data only)
attenuation from pre-rule job orders decided in FY2026

promising_gate: elasticity MDE <= 1.0 (design stage), then after estimation: event-study pre-trend and lead placebo pass, wild bootstrap supports the headline, and at least one alternative treatment (h2a_skill_1 or us_skill_2 or cohort-aligned) agrees
selection_rule: No outcome-based selection. All declared specifications are estimated and reported once the user approves reading FY2026 outcomes; failures are reported. Any later choice is labeled post-outcome.
